acceptanceCriteria: The comment above `setVerdict` states each precedence rule once, including that `insufficient` beats `unknown`, and matches the code and TCP-V0-028.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-3 pull requests. Review of PR #99 (V1-0098): after the review fix the `setVerdict` comment (sufficiency.go:89) says 'one unknown anchor makes it unknown' twice and does not say that insufficient wins over unknown. Wording only; the code and sufficiency_test.go agree with TCP-V0-028.
title: context: `setVerdict` comment repeats the unknown rule and omits that `insufficient` wins over `unknown`
